hotels.title: Stylish Sunshine Coast Stay in Kawana Waters near Pristine Beaches
hotels.description: Set beside the glittering waterways of Kawana Waters, this contemporary retreat places you moments from Bokarina Beach’s long sweep of sand and the scenic coastal path linking Point Cartwright to Currimundi Lake. Sleek rooms and suites pair modern finishes with views across the marina precinct or Glass House Mountains hinterland. A short stroll leads to Sunshine Coast Stadium and the dining hub of Birtinya, where Market Bistro serves polished steakhouse fare and Rice Boi plates up cult-favourite Asian street food. Mooloolaba’s seafood restaurants, the boutiques of Caloundra and the walking trails of Buddina’s coastal reserve are all within easy reach
